selection_rationale: Standard, bounded design-delivery work. Models are an explicit, ordered preference: gpt-6-sol in Codex, claude-sonnet-5-5 in Claude Code; if neither is available the launch is blocked.
task: Independently QA the built Bedroom 2 wardrobe corner against the client-approved concept sketches and the client's 1 Nov observations. Report proportion, alignment, joinery, operability, lighting and buildability defects with evidence; make no edits.
output_contract: Structured independent QA findings for Bedroom 2 with element names, measured model dimensions, sketch comparison, severity, recommended correction and remaining uncertainty; no file edits.
contribution: Found the bedside/sliding-leaf clash, black mirror material, 197 mm compartment, over-wide drawers, uneven niche tiers, small leaf overlap and the 486-521 mm bed lane (findings F1-F16). No edits.
